# graviteeam_application_secret (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM application client secret

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_domain" "example" {
  name = "customer-portal"
  oidc {}
  login_settings {}
}

resource "graviteeam_application" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "customer-web"
  type      = "WEB"

  oauth_settings {
    redirect_uris  = ["https://example.com/callback"]
    grant_types    = ["authorization_code"]
    response_types = ["code"]
    scopes         = ["openid"]
  }
}

resource "graviteeam_application_secret" "example" {
  domain_id      = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  application_id = graviteeam_application.example.id
  name           = "terraform-managed"
  renew_trigger  = "rotation-2026-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the application secret

### Optional

- `renew_trigger` (String) Arbitrary value used to explicitly renew the secret. Changing this value calls the Gravitee AM renewal endpoint and stores the newly returned secret.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) The expiration timestamp of the secret when configured by Gravitee AM
- `id` (String) The ID of the application secret
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The generated client secret value. Gravitee AM only returns the clear value at creation or renewal time.
- `settings_id` (String) The secret settings ID returned by Gravitee AM
